mapper.sql: route_id AS routeId, source_system AS sourceSystem, bucket_id AS bucketId, scan_policy_code AS scanPolicyCode, max_upload_seconds AS maxUploadSeconds, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_file_storage_route ORDER BY source_system
SELECT FROM t_file_storage_route WHERE source_system = #{sourceSystem} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_file_storage_route WHERE bucket_id = #{bucketId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_file_storage_route r JOIN t_file_storage_bucket b ON b.bucket_id = r.bucket_id WHERE b.instance_id = #{instanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_file_storage_route (route_id, source_system, bucket_id, scan_policy_code, max_upload_seconds, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.routeId}, #{row.sourceSystem}, #{row.bucketId}, #{row.scanPolicyCode}, #{row.maxUploadSeconds}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_file_storage_route WHERE route_id = #{row.routeId} AND version = #{row.version}
